frontier.hypothesis: A permuter campaign seeded from the clean floor-19 base reaches the flip where hand-derivation provably cannot, because every hand-enumerable structural axis (duplication, splitting, live-length) is now measured dead and the required construct is a reference-count artefact outside the hand-derivable set.
frontier.mechanism: Random and directed structural mutation explores pseudo partitions and duplication shapes no analytic enumeration covers; the now-validated priority model (predicted 2449 vs measured 2448 in s2) gives a cheap post-filter — score any find's plausibility from its nrefs/livelen with BB2_ALLOC_DEBUG before spending a sandbox run.

frontier.hypothesis: The target's twelve buffer accesses did not all exist as references to ONE pseudo at global_alloc time in the original compile; some reference was created after RA, or the original's flow-time counts differed for a reason not yet identified.
frontier.mechanism: allocno priority is computed from flow/sched-time counts, but the bytes we compare against are post-reorg. s2 checked reorg's delay-slot duplication (no 0xC($sN)/0x14($sN) sits in a delay slot in the target) and this session checked cross-jump (it merges nothing here), but no per-insn provenance table has ever been built for the twelve accesses.
frontier.next_probe: Forensics modality: dump the full RTL insn stream at flow, sched and global_alloc for the candidate form (cc1 -da plus BB2_SCHED_DEBUG/BB2_XJUMP_DEBUG/BB2_RELOAD_DEBUG) and enumerate, insn by insn, every target byte whose reference could have been created after RA — including reload-generated address reloads. Deliverable is a per-insn provenance table for the 12 buffer accesses and the 5 walk accesses, which either finds the slack or proves the counts are pinned end to end.

frontier.hypothesis: The residual is an artefact of having PATCHED our inherited body rather than re-derived the function: a from-scratch reconstruction of func_80078654 from the target bytes (m2c + the matched sibling func_80078824's idioms) may express the buffer as a struct pointer or express the walk differently, giving a pseudo partition no incremental edit of the current body can reach.
frontier.mechanism: Every form measured so far (s1-s3) is a local edit of one inherited body, so the whole search has been confined to one dataflow neighbourhood; the priority model shows the answer must lie in a different partition, and a re-derivation is the only systematic way to leave the neighbourhood by hand.
frontier.next_probe: Rederive modality: run m2c on asm/funcs/func_80078654.s, write the reconstruction verbatim from its output (not from candidate.c), then measure sandbox and the BB2_ALLOC_DEBUG table. Compare the resulting pseudo partition against the target's, and specifically check whether the reconstruction expresses arg0 as a struct pointer with fewer distinct RA-time references.
